messages:
alex_fin: Heads up — NebulaWorks' billing came back with small overage lines (total USD 1,982) split across 3 invoice line items after a reserved-commit rebalancing event. Can we provisionally waive pending reconciliation? Invoices: INV-2026-042, INV-2026-043, INV-2026-044
ben_sales: cc @tara @jordan — customer is pushing for a resolution, they want a provisional credit while we investigate.
tara: Need meter/logs + commit tag. Also need GL code to book any provisional credit. What's the exact commit identifier?
alex_fin: Commit tag = rw-q4-nebula-cc-7. Metering indicates the split happened during a nodepool rebalancer run on 2026-02-03. Snippet of metering lines:```
2026-02-03T03:19:58Z commit=rw-q4-nebula-cc-7 nodepool=nebula-pool-2 region=us-east tokens=124K reserved=true
2026-02-03T03:20:12Z commit=ephemeral nodepool=nebula-pool-2 region=eu-west tokens=11K reserved=false
2026-02-03T03:20:35Z commit=rw-q4-nebula-cc-7 nodepool=nebula-pool-3 region=eu-west tokens=98K reserved=true
```
jordan: That rebalancer job ran at 03:20Z due to host maintenance; it temporarily re-tagged capacity as 'ephemeral' which the billing metering pipeline didn't map back to the reserved commit. I can run a backfill to reassign attribution. @alex_fin do you want us to apply provisional credit now or wait for backfill?
Tara: We can approve a provisional credit up to $2k pending confirmation from revenue ops. @mike_revops can you sign off on a provisional waiver while Jordan runs the backfill?
mike_revops: Approved provisional credit up to USD 2,000. Please create a billing ticket and assign GL 5100 for the provisional hold, hold reason: 'pending backfill attribution'. I need the audit trail before finalizing.
alex_fin: Created ticket BLG-8621 and uploaded the metering excerpts + invoice screenshots. Plan: Jordan will backfill attribution, then finance will post adjustment and invoice PR. @ben_sales can you notify NebulaWorks with an interim note offering provisional credit and ETA 72h?
ben_sales: :thumbsup: I'll send an interim note offering provisional credit and a 72h ETA. Will flag if they push for faster. Any blockers on our side?
jordan: Backfill started. Current progress: reprocessed 14,321 metering events; 87% of disputed usage maps back to commit rw-q4-nebula-cc-7. Estimated adjustment amount: USD 1,872. Pushing reconciliation payload to BLG-8621 now.
tara: I'll review the backfill audit once it's attached to BLG-8621. I will only finalize the credit after audit sign-off; provisional hold remains until then. Thanks everyone.
billing_bot: Ticket BLG-8621 updated: backfill completed; proposed credit USD 1,872; audit report: https://redwood.internal/ops/billing/BLG-8621/audit
